about: The Workbench icons of the DarkWell drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art in art/ is drawn by amiga/icons/draw_art.py (upstream has none). DarkWell-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, DarkWell.info beside the drawer. ReadMe.info is also copied for ReadMe-DarkWell and COPYING.txt.
